content: Hi @Miguel Ojeda Tyr could definitely start using these zerocopy traits, if we could get them into the bindings. Since this series https://lore.kernel.org/rust-for-linux/20261020-b4-gpu_info_intobytes-v5-1-3e0c7c93223c@collabora.com/ mostly touches the rust/Makefile should it go through rust-next ? If it went in 7.5 then we could probably wait until 7.6 to use it in Tyr @Alice Ryhl
We can also land it and give you a tag if you want to depend on it on the same cycle, i.e. 7.5
